Name: Ministry of Intelligence, Invetigations and Operations
Details: Formed in 2798, the Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations is the civilian intelligence arm of the Federated Suns. Ostensibly, MIIO is charged with detecting and stopping internal threats to the state while the DMI handles external threats, though that distinction has been blurred over the centuries and there is considerable overlap between the two. Despite this, both the MIIO and DMI have a long history of close cooperation to ensure the safety and security of the Federated Suns.
